description: This file is a Markdown document serving as a comprehensive integration guide for using Letta with LiteLLM via both proxy and SDK methods. It includes setup instructions, code snippets, example workflows, best practices, troubleshooting tips, and references, all aimed at building and managing AI agents with memory and multi-language support.
